t: Ghassan Zaqtan - Wikipedia
s: October 20, 2025 - Ghassan Zaqtan (Arabic: غسان زقطان; born 1954) is a Palestinian poet, author of ten collections of poetry. He is also a novelist, editor. He was born in Beit Jala, near Bethlehem, and has lived in Jordan, Beirut, Damascus, and Tunis. His book “Like a Straw Bird it Follows me” translated by Fady Joudah was awarded the 2013 International Griffin Poetry Prize.
